I can't fully confirm that. No thermal detections intersected ASSET-F14 between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12. However, coverage was not complete for every sensor.

- VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21 and MODIS covered the whole period.
- VIIRS S-NPP has a gap from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06. FIRMS did not make data available for those days.

The run's rule says a sensor counts as covered only if it has every day of the period. By that rule, S-NPP does not qualify, so the "no detections" result is not complete for all sensors.

Three other sensors did cover those days and found nothing, which reduces the risk of a missed event. A short fire seen only by S-NPP's overpasses in that window could still be missed.

To close the gap, you could re-run the query once S-NPP data for 2–6 November becomes available. You could also state the result as "no detections, with a four-day S-NPP gap."
